name: tzdb_initialize
title: Initialize tzdb for usage in other packages

origin.description: Load tzdb so its database path is set and its callables are registered.
origin.details: The function body returns NULL. Loading the package runs the startup hook that points the database at the bundled text files.

translation.description: Return None. Importing the package is what locates the text time zone database.
translation.details: The call itself does no work. Names and version read the database when they are called.
